The guide is structured to provide all the necessary details you need to confidently explore Venice's hidden gems and famous landmarks alike. By organizing information into distinct categories, you can easily tailor your itinerary to your personal interests.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this guide suitable for first-time visitors?**
A: Absolutely. The visual nature and the curated "Top 10" lists are perfect for newcomers, providing a clear roadmap of must-see locations without being overwhelming.

**Q: Does it only focus on tourist sites?**

**Q: Are printed maps included?**
